name: LinkedIn Content Automation (V2 — Supabase Memory + Gemini 2.5)

nodes.name: Read Ideation Sheet
nodes.notes: Reads the Content Ideation sheet. Expected columns: A=Topic, B=Brand (CloudPulse/Synthetix AI), C=Angle, D=Status (pending/drafted/published).

nodes.name: Has Pending Idea?
nodes.notes: Branch TRUE → use sheet idea. Branch FALSE → scrape the web for a fresh topic.

nodes.name: Gemini: Find Trending Topic
nodes.notes: Fallback: if the ideation sheet is empty, ask Gemini to find a fresh topic from recent news.

nodes.name: Normalize Sheet Data
nodes.notes: Normalizes the sheet row into a standard {topic, brand, angle} payload for downstream nodes.

nodes.name: Normalize Scraped Data
nodes.notes: Parses the Gemini JSON response and normalizes it into the same {topic, brand, angle} format.

nodes.name: Merge
nodes.notes: Merges both branches back into a single stream. Only one branch fires per execution.

nodes.name: Brand Router
nodes.notes: Routes to the correct system prompt based on brand: CloudPulse → Output 0, Synthetix AI → Output 1.

nodes.name: Gemini: Draft CloudPulse Post
nodes.notes: Generates the full LinkedIn post (caption, first comment, visual prompt) for CloudPulse using Gemini.

nodes.name: Gemini: Draft Synthetix AI Post
nodes.notes: Generates the full LinkedIn post (caption, first comment, visual prompt) for Synthetix AI using Gemini.

nodes.name: Merge Post Output
nodes.notes: Merges both brand outputs back into a single stream.

nodes.name: Parse AI Output
nodes.notes: Extracts caption, first_comment, and carousel_visual_prompt from the Gemini response.

nodes.name: Gemini: Generate Carousel Image
nodes.notes: Takes the carousel_visual_prompt and generates the cover slide image via Gemini Imagen. The response will contain a base64-encoded image.

nodes.name: Convert Base64 to Image
nodes.notes: Decodes the base64 image from Gemini into a binary PNG file for upload.

nodes.name: Upload Image to Drive
nodes.notes: Uploads the generated carousel image to the designated Google Drive folder.

nodes.name: Update Content Calendar
nodes.notes: Writes the generated caption, comment, image link, and status back to the Content Calendar sheet.

nodes.name: Discord: Review Notification
nodes.notes: Sends a rich notification to the #content-review Discord channel with a preview of the caption, the image link, and a request to review.

nodes.name: Error Handler (Discord)
nodes.notes: Catches any pipeline error and sends a detailed alert to Discord so the team can debug.

nodes.name: Supabase (CloudPulse LI Context)
nodes.notes: Pulls brand voice, ICP, and past LinkedIn examples from GrowthAgent memory for CloudPulse.

nodes.name: Supabase (Synthetix AI LI Context)
nodes.notes: Pulls brand voice, ICP, and past LinkedIn examples from GrowthAgent memory for Synthetix AI.

nodes.name: LinkedIn: Publish to CloudPulse Company Page
nodes.notes: Publishes the generated caption and design to the CloudPulse company page on LinkedIn.

main.node: LinkedIn: Publish to CloudPulse Company Page
